title: What's New: AL - Language (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Table Changes and Text Search Optimization
Page Style Enum and Profile Extensions

features.name: Optimized for Text Search Property
features.description: New property for table fields that allows specifying which fields should be indexed for optimized text search. Available in field references via the is optimized for search property.

features.name: Configuration Dialogue Page Type
features.description: New page type called configuration dialogue as part of AI investment, but currently under development and cannot be used yet.
caveats: Cannot be used until feature is complete

features.name: Prompting Actions on Pages
features.description: Prompting actions can now be used on more page types including card pages, list pages, and document pages to showcase copilot features.

features.name: Page Style Enum
features.description: New enum for page styling that eliminates hardcoded style expressions like favorable and unfavorable, allowing developers to use enumerated page styles instead.

features.name: Profile Extensions
features.description: Profiles can now be extended with additional customizations, allowing developers to build on existing profiles instead of copying and creating new ones.

features.name: Clear Layout, Clear Actions, and Clear Views Properties
features.description: Three new properties for page customizations: clear layout clears all page layout, clear actions removes all actions, and clear views clears existing list views. Developers must then add back only needed elements.
caveats: Using clear methods in page customizations used in role customizations will cause errors

features.name: Query Tool Tips
features.description: Queries can now have tool tips added to help users understand what data is used for and how to read it.

features.name: Query JSON Save Support
features.description: Queries can now be saved as JSON, allowing easy data transfer back and forth in JSON format.

features.name: Extendable Interfaces
features.description: Interfaces can now be extended, allowing developers to build on existing interfaces and expand them with more methods instead of creating completely new interfaces.

features.name: New Interface Keywords (is and as)
features.description: New keywords is and as have been added for working with interfaces to improve modularization and code base structure.

features.name: List of Code Units
features.description: Developers can now use list of code units, extending the available collection types. Code units can be assigned to interfaces with simple casting.
caveats: Code units must implement the interface to be assigned

features.name: Date and Time Properties
features.description: New properties added to date, date-time, and time types including day of week, month, day, year, hour, minute, second, and millisecond, making date/time logic easier to write.

features.name: Self Reference (this)
features.description: A self reference keyword has been added to the language allowing code to reference the object it is currently in, useful for passing self to other functions and qualifying variables.

features.name: Code Analyzer for Self Reference
features.description: A code analyzer and code action is available to enforce self reference prefixes where needed across single instances or entire documents, projects, and workspaces.

features.name: NavApp Get Source Method
features.description: New method under the NavApp type called get Source that takes a resource name and stream, allowing developers to ship resources with their apps.

features.name: Session Information AI Tokens Used
features.description: New method in session information type called AI tokens used for tracking AI token consumption, but not yet ready for consumption.

features.name: HTTP Client PATCH Method
features.description: New method for HTTP client allowing easy PATCH operations to send a delta of changes to a service, simplifying CRUD update logic.

features.name: Ternary Operator
features.description: The ternary operator has been added to AL language as a way to simplify if-else statements with a condition and two possible outcomes, condensing multi-line logic into single expressions.
caveats: Can become difficult to read for new people
